knn_distance.distance: mean Euclidean distance to k nearest train-fit events

class_conditional_gaussian_mixture.definition: negative log likelihood under an empirical-prior mixture of one full-covariance Gaussian per background class

local_global.definition: mean local-to-global-anchor MSE in raw latent coordinates

local_global_cosine.definition: mean 1-cosine-similarity from local views to the global anchor

local_global_normalized_mse.definition: mean MSE after L2-normalizing local views and the global anchor; equal to 2*cosine_distance/latent_dim up to floating-point error

two_sided_local_global.definition: -log of the two-sided empirical tail probability under the train-fit background local-global score distribution

triplet_response.definition: event-level triplet response from generated positive views and corrupted negative views; larger margin/hinge scores indicate weaker learned separation

triplet_distance_gap.score_used_for_auc: negative distance gap, i.e. d_pos - d_neg
